purpose: Dated propulsion-system reference facts and modeling boundaries for non-authoritative Rev-C trade studies.

mbs_g1.motor_mount_pattern: common 4-hole pattern, 44 mm diagonal hole spacing

vesc_modeling_boundary.approximate_relation_note: VESC documentation explains battery/input current as a fraction of motor current depending on modulation/duty cycle; the X1 solver therefore estimates battery current from electrical power and pack voltage rather than equating it to motor phase current.

model_boundaries: motor Kt derived from Kv is an idealized planning proxy and does not include winding resistance, saturation, field weakening, commutation losses or controller-specific behavior
battery current estimate is a steady-state input-power approximation and is not a VESC configuration value
traction uses a quasi-static axle normal-load model and does not capture lateral transfer, tire sinkage, transient suspension, wheel hop or detailed soil mechanics
no-load geometric speed is not a ride-speed prediction
a first-order current/power envelope does not establish continuous thermal capability
declared current, ERPM, power, voltage, efficiency and friction assumptions must come from a candidate data sheet, selected builder, or explicit study assumption
Issue #19 physical brake-drive topology remains upstream of final propulsion selection
